name: Ousama Ren'ai
source:
Born into one of Japan's most prestigious families, the protagonist, Ten'ou Hajime, secured an unshakable position at a young age through his natural talent and relentless hard work.

Unfortunately, however, he was incapable of understanding the emotion known as "love." It was a flaw born from the mindset of an overwhelmingly self-important elite who believed it was only natural for everyone to adore him.

"But even if I wanted to fall in love, there's no one around me except oddballs."
"And the biggest oddball of all is you, Master."
"You probably never even realized it. How sad."

Can a man who gets teased like this by his two maids really experience a normal romance? No - of course he can't.

[MTLed from the [url=https://asa-pro.com/ousama/]official website[/url]]
